limits: Standalone sealed donor arithmetic operators, not complete production API/module speedups.
Each batch counts output polynomials. Chain computes sum over L polynomial products (L=4/5/7); no SHAKE, decomposition or full matrix-vector K rows.
Split chain includes two batched forward kernels, a pointwise dot kernel and inverse kernel. Fused chain uses one kernel; identical inputs and modular outputs.
All backends accept canonical int32 input and produce canonical int32 output. Tensor timing includes byte packing, WMMA layout adaptation and output normalization.
Inverse output uses R/256 normalization (invntt_tomont). Pointwise uses Montgomery R^-1, so complete chains output ordinary negacyclic products.
512 deterministic request rows include all 256 basis directions and random/edge data; rows are tiled across batches and reused by three processes.
All variants qualify before any formal timing. Every coefficient is checked initially and finally; individual timed intermediate outputs are not separately checked.
Raw CUDA-event timing excludes allocation, CPU reference work, and host/device transfers; includes all split launches and wrapper operations.
Shared lock and pre/post GPU idle samples are used; continuous exclusive GPU ownership is not established.
Local CPU tests cannot establish CUDA compilation/device correctness. Server build and every correctness check must pass before acceptance.
